items.name: malt-carry-folder
items.label: 麦芽糖手提文件夹
items.prompt: Create a premium app logo symbol for a Chinese file transfer product named Nayy. The symbol must be wordless: no typography, no readable letters, no Chinese characters, no numbers, no watermark. Use a warm malt candy / amber honey color palette, semi-transparent glassy material, soft rounded forms, subtle depth, clean silhouette, centered composition, high legibility at favicon size, production-grade brand mark, not a generic cloud icon, not a normal office folder icon. Use a very light warm off-white background only for presentation. Main concept: a translucent amber carry-folder with a soft rounded handle at the top, like a small tote bag for files. The folder body has two subtle inner file layers visible through glass. Edges have caramel highlights, no harsh shadows, no text.
